select * from ( select icb.TRD_ID execid , fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId , icb.INSTRUMENT_ID finprodMarketId , icb.INSTRUMENT_SHORT_NAME finprodAbbr , decode(icb.ISSUE_METHOD,'6','01','01') issuetype , deal.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId , stlinfo.SEC_ACCT_NAME secManageAcctIdName , icb.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT*10000 subscriptionAmount , icb.ACTUAL_FEE payableAmount , bo.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt , icb.ISSUE_PRICE issuePrice , icb.SPREAD bp , icb.COUPON_RATE rate , decode(icb.COUPON_RATE_TYPE,'1','01','3','02','2','03','4','0','01') couponRateType , fp.ccy ccy , icb.ISSUER issuer , mcci1.PARTY_ABBR issuerName , icb.SUBSCRIBE_INSTITUTION_ID ouPartyId , mcci.PARTY_ABBR ouPartyIdAbbr , icb.SUBMIT_USER ourTrader , mcct.TRADER_NAME ourTraderName , to_date(substr(icb.SUBSCRIPTION_TIME, 0, 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate , null remark ,'BID' as finprodType2 from INTERF_CSTP_BJFXJG icb left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on icb.INSTRUMENT_ID = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join TRDQUTO_MATCH_INFO tmi on tmi.CSTP_TRADE_ID = icb.TRD_ID left join BID_ORDER bo on bo.BID_ID = tmi.PRE_TRADE_ID left join (select distinct bobp.BID_ID, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on eed.ENTRUST_ID = bobp.ENTRUST_ID and bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID) deal on deal.BID_ID = bo.BID_ID left join stl_sec_acct_info stlinfo on deal.SEC_ACCT_ID = stlinfo.sec_acct_id left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci on mcci.PARTY_ID = icb.SUBSCRIBE_INSTITUTION_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci1 on mcci1.PARTY_ID = icb.ISSUER_21_FIRM_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_TRADER mcct on mcct.TRADER_ID = icb.SUBMIT_USER where icb.TRD_ID=#{exeid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
order by ${sort} ${direction}

select * from ( select distinct tr.oritradeid as execid, tr.dealdate as tradeDate, tr.term_type as termType, tr.ps as ps, tr.ourdepositaccountnumber as secManageAcctId,
stlinfo.sec_acct_name as secManageAcctIdName, decode(tr.settle_speed,'1','01','2','02','3','03') settleSpeed, tr.term as repoTerm, to_date(I.Settldate,'yyyy-MM-dd') as vsettleDate, to_date(I.Settldate2,'yyyy-MM-dd') as msettleDate, I.Cashholdingdays as actRepoTerm, I.Price*100 as tradeYield, DECODE(I.MARKETINDICATOR, 9, I.TRADECASHAMT, 10, I.SETTLCURRAMT) as tradeAmt, I.Accruedinteresttotalamt as mintAmt, I.Settlcurramt2 as mtradeAmt, tr.deal_feeamt as trdFeeAmt, tr.sett_feeamt as settleFeeAmt, decode(I.Clearingmethod,'13','01','6','02') as clearType, decode(I.Deliverytype,'0','03','5','02','4','01') as deliveryType, decode(I.Deliverytype2,'0','03','5','02','4','01') as mdeliveryType, I.Settlcurrency as settCcy, I.Quoteid as quoteid, I.ourinstitutioncode as traderid, mccit.PARTY_ABBR as traderidName, su.real_name trader, I.Counterinstitutioncode as counterId, mccic.PARTY_ABBR as counterIdName, I.COUNTERTRADERCHINESENAME as counterTrader, tr.dealtext as remark from INTERF_CSTP_TRADE I INNER JOIN (SELECT EXECID ,MAX(UPDATETIME) UPDATETIME FROM INTERF_CSTP_TRADE GROUP BY EXECID) II ON II.EXECID = I.EXECID AND II.UPDATETIME = I.UPDATETIME left join INTERF_OPICS_TRAD_REPO tr on tr.oritradeid = I.EXECID
LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ADD sua ON tr.BUYTRADER =sua.IBU_TRADER LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su ON sua.USER_ID =su.USER_ID left join stl_sec_acct_info stlinfo on tr.ourdepositaccountnumber=stlinfo.sec_acct_id LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mccit ON I.ourinstitutioncode= mccit.party_customer_id LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mccic ON I.Counterinstitutioncode= mccic.party_customer_id where I.EXECID=#{exeid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
order by ${sort} ${direction}
select T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.ENTRUST_NUM shareNum from ETR_ENTRUST T1 where T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
select mcp.COUNTER_ID from MST_COUNTER_PARTY mcp INNER JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci ON mcp.PARTY_ID = mcci.PARTY_ID WHERE mcci.PARTY_ID = #{cpPartyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select reg.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID as finprodId,reg.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 as pledgeRatio, reg.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId,reg.ENTRUST_ID as entrustId, reg.PLEDGE_NUMBER*100 as pledgePrin from REG_FIN_PLEDGE reg where reg.trade_id =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select reg.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID as finprodId,reg.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 as pledgeRatio, reg.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId,reg.ENTRUST_ID as entrustId, reg.PLEDGE_NUMBER*100 as pledgePrin from ibu_quote_ent_crep_pledge reg where reg.quote_id =#{quoteId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and reg.entrust_id=#{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select t.pre_trade_id as preTradeId from trdquto_match_info t where t.exe_id=#{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.match_status is null
select t.pre_trade_id as preTradeId from trdquto_match_info t where t.CSTP_TRADE_ID=#{cstpTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.match_status ='01' and rownum=1

select * from ( select ic.pledge_finprod_id as pledgeFinprodId, ic.pledge_ratio as pledgeRatio, ic.pledge_number*100 as pledgeFaceValue from ibu_quote_crep_pledge ic where ic.quote_id=#{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union select reg.pledge_finprod_id as pledgeFinprodId, reg.pledge_ratio as pledgeRatio, sum(reg.pledge_number*100) as pledgeFaceValue from REG_FIN_PLEDGE reg inner join reg_fin_product_deal deal on reg.trade_id=deal.trade_id where deal.totle_trade_id=#{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by reg.pledge_finprod_id,reg.pledge_ratio) order by pledgeFinprodId

select fprepo.finprod_id as pledgeFinprodId, itr.CONVRATE as pledgeRatio, itr.FACETOTALAMT as pledgeFaceValue from interf_opics_trad_repo repo inner join INTERF_TRAD_REPOASST itr on repo.oritradeid=itr.tradeid inner join fin_product fprepo on fprepo.finprod_market_id= itr.SECID|| '.' || repo.MARKET and fprepo.finprod_type='F01' where itr.tradeid=#{execid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by fprepo.finprod_id
select finprod_id,ISSUE_STATUS from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ROWNUM = 1
